title: Suspected Duplicate Charge - Whole Foods Market
description: Cardholder reports being charged twice for a grocery purchase at Whole Foods Market on 2024-03-15. First charge of $127.43 posted on 3/15, second charge of $127.43 posted on 3/16. Cardholder states they only made one visit to the store.

title: Pending Authorization Not Released - Hilton Hotels
description: Cardholder checked out of Hilton Garden Inn on 2024-03-10 but a $450.00 authorization hold from check-in on 2024-03-07 has not been released. The actual room charge of $387.50 has settled. Cardholder is concerned about the additional hold reducing available credit.

title: Refund Not Received - Amazon.com
description: Cardholder returned an item to Amazon on 2024-02-28 and received a refund confirmation email with ARN REF-AMZ-20240228-7741. As of 2024-03-18, the refund of $89.99 has not posted to the account. Amazon customer service confirms refund was processed on 2024-03-01.

title: Settlement Delay - Delta Air Lines
description: Cardholder purchased airline tickets on 2024-02-20 for $1,247.00. Authorization was approved but the transaction has not settled after 25 days. The flight is scheduled for 2024-04-15. Cardholder is concerned the charge is still pending.

title: Partial Reversal Confusion - Best Buy
description: Cardholder purchased a laptop and accessories totaling $1,899.97 at Best Buy on 2024-03-12. They returned the accessories ($342.98) on 2024-03-14. A partial credit of $342.98 posted, but the original charge still shows $1,899.97 instead of $1,556.99. Cardholder believes they are being overcharged.

title: Merchant Descriptor Mismatch - Uber Eats
description: Cardholder does not recognize a charge of $47.82 posted on 2024-03-16 from 'UBER *EATS PENDING'. They confirm using Uber for rides but deny using Uber Eats. Transaction appears to be from a different merchant descriptor than expected.

title: High-Value Duplicate Charge - Luxury Auto Service
description: Cardholder reports two identical charges of $8,750.00 from 'Premium Auto Service Center' on 2024-03-13 and 2024-03-14. Cardholder confirms only one service appointment. Amount exceeds standard auto-resolution threshold.

title: Multiple Pending Authorizations - Enterprise Rent-A-Car
description: Cardholder has three pending authorizations from Enterprise Rent-A-Car: $275.00 (3/5), $275.00 (3/8), and $412.50 (3/12). Only one rental agreement exists. The final settlement should be $412.50 for a 7-day rental with fuel charge.

title: Insufficient Evidence - Disputed Gas Station Charge
description: Cardholder disputes a $92.14 charge at Shell Gas Station on 2024-03-17, claiming they did not visit that location. No additional details provided. Account shows regular gas purchases at various locations.

title: Refund Amount Exceeds Original - Nordstrom
description: A refund of $234.50 posted from Nordstrom on 2024-03-15, but the original transaction was $189.99 on 2024-02-28. The refund exceeds the original charge by $44.51. This requires immediate review per policy POL-TXN-003 Section 2.2.

title: Timeline Inconsistency - Target Store Settlement Before Auth
description: Transaction timeline shows a settlement of $156.78 from Target posted on 2024-03-10, but the corresponding authorization was not recorded until 2024-03-12. The settlement date precedes the authorization date by 2 days, which violates expected transaction sequence order. Cardholder confirms the purchase was made on 2024-03-09.

title: Timeline Inconsistency - Refund Before Purchase
description: Account shows a refund credit of $75.00 from HomeDepot posted on 2024-03-05, but the original purchase transaction of $75.00 was not posted until 2024-03-08. The refund appears to have been processed before the original charge existed. This sequence inconsistency needs investigation.

title: Policy Eligibility Dispute - Multiple Applicable Policies
description: Cardholder reports a charge of $320.00 from a hotel that appears twice and also has a pending authorization hold of $400.00. The case involves both a potential duplicate charge (POL-TXN-001) and a pending authorization issue (POL-TXN-002). Need to determine which policy applies as the primary resolution path.

title: Policy Eligibility - No Matching Policy for Cryptocurrency Purchase Dispute
description: Cardholder disputes a charge of $2,500.00 from 'COINBASE *PURCHASE' claiming they did not authorize the purchase. Existing policies do not have specific guidance for cryptocurrency exchange disputes. The transaction completed via 3D-Secure authentication which complicates the dispute eligibility.

title: Account Servicing Exception - Late Fee Charged Despite On-Time Payment
description: Cardholder was charged a $39.00 late payment fee on their March 2024 statement despite payment being received on 2024-03-01, which is 5 days before the due date of 2024-03-06. Payment confirmation shows the amount was debited from their bank account on 2024-02-28. Cardholder requests fee reversal.

title: Account Servicing Exception - Credit Limit Not Reflecting Payment
description: Cardholder made a payment of $3,000.00 on 2024-03-10 to their credit card with a $15,000 credit limit. As of 2024-03-15, the available credit still shows the pre-payment amount. The payment has cleared their bank account. Account status shows no holds or restrictions.

title: Duplicate Charge - Small Amount Restaurant
description: Cardholder was charged twice for a restaurant meal at Olive Garden. Original charge of $34.56 posted on 2024-03-18, identical second charge posted on 2024-03-18. Tip amount of $6.91 was included in both charges. Cardholder only dined once.

title: Settlement Delay - International E-Commerce Purchase
description: Cardholder purchased electronics from a UK-based online retailer on 2024-02-25 for $678.90 (converted from GBP 535.00). Authorization approved but no settlement after 22 days. International transactions have extended settlement windows. Cardholder concerned about exchange rate fluctuation if it settles later.

title: Reversal Confusion - Subscription Cancellation
description: Cardholder cancelled a $14.99/month subscription with a streaming service on 2024-03-01. A reversal credit of $14.99 posted on 2024-03-05, but a new charge of $14.99 posted on 2024-03-10. Cardholder believes they are still being charged after cancellation. Merchant claims the new charge is for the final billing cycle.

title: Merchant Descriptor Mismatch - Parent Company Name
description: Cardholder does not recognize a charge of $225.00 from 'YUM BRANDS INC' posted on 2024-03-14. After investigation, the charge appears to be from a Taco Bell catering order. The merchant descriptor shows the parent company name rather than the restaurant brand. Cardholder confirms placing a catering order but expected 'TACO BELL' on their statement.

title: Zero-Amount Authorization Hold
description: Cardholder reports a $0.00 charge from a gas station on 2024-03-17. This is a pre-authorization hold that was never settled. Cardholder is concerned about the zero-dollar entry on their statement.

title: Exact High-Value Threshold - $5,000 Dispute
description: Cardholder disputes a charge of exactly $5,000.00 from an electronics retailer, claiming the item was never delivered. The merchant shows delivery confirmation to a different address. Amount sits exactly at the high-value escalation boundary.

title: Extreme High-Value Transaction - Operations Manager Required
description: Corporate cardholder reports an unauthorized charge of $150,000.00 from an equipment leasing company. The charge posted on 2024-03-01. Cardholder denies any relationship with the merchant. Card was not reported lost or stolen. Amount exceeds L3 escalation threshold.

title: Minimal Description Case
description: Charge not recognized.

title: Mixed Signals - Duplicate AND Pending Authorization
description: Cardholder sees two identical charges of $312.00 from Home Depot posted on 2024-03-14 and 2024-03-14. Additionally, there is a pending authorization hold of $312.00 from the same merchant that has not settled after 5 days. Cardholder made one purchase. This could be a duplicate charge or a stale pending auth or both.

title: Negative Amount - Unexpected Refund Credit
description: Cardholder's statement shows a credit of -$89.99 from Amazon that they did not expect. They did not return any items or request a refund. The negative amount entry is confusing and the cardholder wants to understand why money was added to their account.

title: Foreign Currency Edge Case - Japanese Yen (No Decimals)
description: Cardholder made a purchase in Tokyo for ¥15,000 (approximately $100 USD) on 2024-03-10. The charge posted as $100.00 but the cardholder expected a different conversion rate. JPY has no decimal places. The authorization was in JPY but settlement converted to USD at a rate the cardholder disputes.

title: Same Merchant Different Amounts - Not a Duplicate
description: Cardholder reports two charges from Starbucks on the same day (2024-03-18): $5.75 and $4.25. Cardholder claims they only visited once. However, the two charges are for different amounts ($5.75 morning coffee, $4.25 afternoon drink). The transactions have different authorization codes and different timestamps (9:15 AM and 2:30 PM).

title: Expired Dispute Window - 8 Month Old Transaction
description: Cardholder is disputing a charge of $450.00 from July 2023 (2023-07-15) that they claim was fraudulent. The cardholder only noticed the charge during their annual statement review. The transaction is over 8 months old, well outside the standard 60-day and extended 120-day dispute windows.

title: Contradictory Evidence - 3D-Secure Authenticated but Claimed Unauthorized
description: Cardholder claims a $1,200.00 charge from an online electronics store on 2024-03-15 was unauthorized. However, the transaction was authenticated via 3D-Secure (Verified by Visa) with the cardholder's registered device. The OTP was sent to the cardholder's phone number on file and was correctly entered. IP address matches cardholder's home location. Despite all authentication evidence, cardholder maintains they did not make the purchase.
